title: Cloud Sync usage
summary: Diceroll's Cloud Sync page, Usage tab: players with data, storage used against the product's total, syncs today and save conflicts, storage by tier against each limit, what's stored (saves, older versions, settings) and where players sync from.
compare: Read from the directory, never computed in the console. The numbers agree with Setup: 4,812 players with data = 3,120 Free + 1,402 Standard + 290 Deluxe; 18.4 GiB of 50 GiB = 9.5 + 5.5 + 3.4 GiB by tier = 11.6 + 6.6 + 0.2 GiB by kind; 41 Free players over 80%.

Storage by tier shows each tier's limit in words, players with data, storage used, the median per player and who's over 80%, as warning text only where it needs attention, with the players whose saves wait for room linked.
What's stored is one stacked bar with a legend; older versions say they count toward each player's storage.
Where players sync from lists each platform the product builds for, with players this week and the last sync; a platform with no syncs says Not seen yet and links to Integration.
A player's own data is on Users → the player → Data, and the card foot says so; this tab has no per-player table.

Words: "player" for a game (Diceroll), "person" or "account" for an app (DJDL); storage in MiB and GiB, never MB; numbers and units never break across lines. products.integration's Cloud Sync card must say "Storage per person: 256 MiB by default (Standard uses the default)" to match this page.
Phone: the stats stack two by two, each tier row becomes a block (tier and storage used, then the rest), and the two cards stack.
